title: Lumos prekey bundle
$comment: Public prekey material published for asynchronous session establishment (TRS Sec. 10.1). ONLY PUBLIC MATERIAL APPEARS HERE. The long-term identity private key is hardware-backed, non-exportable and never escrowed (ADR-003); no field of this schema may ever carry private key bytes. prekey_kind is a typed enum rather than a boolean so that adding a future kind - a post-quantum prekey, say - is an additive change under TRS-EXT and TRS-PROTO-016, not a reinterpretation of an existing field.
x-curve: X25519 for key agreement, Ed25519 for signatures (ADR-001, libsodium).

signature.$comment: Ed25519 over the canonical encoding of kind | key_id | public_key, signed by identity_key. A bundle whose signature does not verify is rejected with ERR_CONFIG_SIGNATURE_INVALID.

created_at.$comment: Unix seconds. Rotation cadence is sessions_remote_text.SIGNED_PREKEY_ROTATION_DAYS; the register is the only source for that value.

one_time_prekey.$comment: Consumed once and never re-served. Server-side stock and replenishment thresholds come from ONE_TIME_PREKEYS_UPLOADED and PREKEY_REPLENISH_THRESHOLD.

key32.$comment: 32 bytes, lowercase hex. Test vectors use keys namespaced TESTONLY- in their surrounding metadata; no production key material ever appears in this repository.
